text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services has been directed by North York Community Council to investigate and report back on a speed limit reduction on collector and minor arterial streets in Ward 15 from 50 km/h to 40 km/h. The review disclosed the implementation of a 40 km/h speed limit is warranted on six streets and is recommended to address safety concerns expressed by the Ward Councillor and area residents.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Blossomfield Drive, between Flemington Road and Lawrence Avenue West. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Covington Road, between Brucewood Crescent and Bathurst Street. 3. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Englemount Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and Reddick Court. 4. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Flemington Road, between Ranee Avenue and Amaranth Court. 5. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Ranee Avenue, between Flemington Road and Bathurst Street. 6. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Yorkdale Road, between Dufferin Street and the exit ramp onto southbound Allen Road. 7.
